transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad, and it's just not getting any better. This constant down mood has been going on for about a year and seven months now.
Have you had periods of feeling relatively well between episodes, or has the low mood been present most of the time without much relief?

It has been present almost constantly without any relief. I haven't had any periods of feeling well or like myself during this entire year and seven months. It just feels like a continuous, heavy sadness every single day.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities, even things you used to enjoy?
Yes, I've completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to enjoy. I don't get any pleasure or happiness from them anymore, and everything just feels completely flat and numb.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over this period?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or my weight during this time. It feels like they've stayed pretty much the same as before.
Have you been having trouble with your sleep, such as difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
No, I haven't really noticed any major changes or problems with my sleep. It seems to be pretty much the same as it has always been.
Do you often feel tired or low on energy, even when you haven't done much physically?
Yes, I constantly feel completely exhausted and drained of energy. My body always feels heavy and tired even if I haven't done anything physical, making it really hard to get through my daily tasks.
To help confirm the diagnosis, can you recall if these symptoms—low mood, loss of interest, and low energy—have been present most of the day, more days than not, for at least two years?
Yes, those symptoms have definitely been there almost every single day, most of the day. However, it hasn't quite been two years yet. It has been going on for about one year and seven months now.
Have you experienced any similar periods of low mood or loss of interest before this current episode, even if they were less severe or didn't last as long?
No, I haven't experienced anything like this before. This is the first time I've ever felt this kind of constant low mood and loss of interest.

Since the symptoms have been ongoing for 1 year and 7 months and haven't reached 2 years, have you had any other depressive symptoms or episodes in the past, even if they were shorter or milder, that might extend the overall timeline of your depressive experience?

No, I don't recall ever having any other depressive episodes or similar symptoms before this current period began. Before these past one year and seven months, I felt completely fine and didn't experience anything like this.
Thank you for sharing. Based on what you've described, we can discuss treatment options for persistent depressive disorder. How has this condition been affecting your daily life and functioning?

It has made daily life incredibly difficult because the constant fatigue makes even basic chores or work feel almost impossible to start or finish. I struggle to focus on simple tasks or make basic decisions, and I've pulled away from friends because socializing just takes too much effort.
